verdict.rationale: Basecamp's pricing page explicitly claims official support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents with full MCP support. That is first-party support for connecting agents to Basecamp over MCP, alongside a CLI and skills for local agents. The claim rests on a single marketing line with no setup or server documentation. missing for 10: MCP server setup/connection docs, endpoint or tool listing, auth details for the MCP connection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
